title: Grammar and Sentence Structure — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "never / late / is / school / she / for"

visual.text: She is never late for school.

choices.say: She is never late for school.

visual.text: She is late never for school.

choices.say: She is late never for school.

visual.text: Never she is late for school.

choices.say: Never she is late for school.

visual.text: She is never for school late.

choices.say: She is never for school late.

items.reteach: Adverb of frequency diletakkan setelah "be": is never late.

items.prompt: Combine into a compound sentence: "The bus broke down." + "We walked to the village."

visual.text: The bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

visual.text: The bus broke down, but we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, but we walked to the village.

visual.text: The bus broke down, or we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, or we walked to the village.

visual.text: Although the bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

choices.say: Although the bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

items.prompt: Combine into a complex sentence: "It was raining." + "The match continued."

visual.text: Although it was raining, the match continued.

choices.say: Although it was raining, the match continued.

visual.text: Because it was raining, the match continued.

choices.say: Because it was raining, the match continued.

visual.text: Although it was raining, but the match continued.

choices.say: Although it was raining, but the match continued.

visual.text: It was raining although, the match continued.

choices.say: It was raining although, the match continued.

items.prompt: Change into a yes/no question: "She has finished her homework."

visual.text: Has she finished her homework?

choices.say: Has she finished her homework?

items.prompt: Rewrite "What time does the ferry leave?" starting with "Do you know …"

visual.text: Do you know what time the ferry leaves?

choices.say: Do you know what time the ferry leaves?

visual.text: Do you know what time does the ferry leave?

choices.say: Do you know what time does the ferry leave?

visual.text: Do you know what time the ferry leave?

choices.say: Do you know what time the ferry leave?

visual.text: Do you know the ferry what time leaves?

choices.say: Do you know the ferry what time leaves?

items.reteach: Pertanyaan tak langsung: tanpa "does", verb mengikuti subjek (leaves).

items.prompt: Turn "Your mother works at the hospital" into a tag question.

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't she?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, isn't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, isn't she?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't he?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't he?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, don't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, don't she?

items.prompt: Fix the fragment: "Because the road to Bromo was foggy."

visual.text: We drove slowly because the road to Bromo was foggy.

choices.say: We drove slowly because the road to Bromo was foggy.

visual.text: Because the road to Bromo was foggy and slowly.

choices.say: Because the road to Bromo was foggy and slowly.

visual.text: Because the road to Bromo was very foggy.

choices.say: Because the road to Bromo was very foggy.

visual.text: Because foggy the road to Bromo was.

choices.say: Because foggy the road to Bromo was.

items.reteach: Tambahkan klausa utama agar kalimat lengkap.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "most / of / the / students / passed / the / test"

visual.text: Most of the students passed the test.

choices.say: Most of the students passed the test.

visual.text: The most of students passed the test.

choices.say: The most of students passed the test.

visual.text: Most the of students passed the test.

choices.say: Most the of students passed the test.

visual.text: Of the most students passed the test.

choices.say: Of the most students passed the test.

items.reteach: Pola quantifier: most of the + noun jamak.

items.prompt: Rewrite using "as … as": "Ayu is 155 cm tall. Rina is also 155 cm tall."

visual.text: Ayu is as tall as Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as tall as Rina.

visual.text: Ayu is taller as Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is taller as Rina.

visual.text: Ayu is as taller as Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as taller as Rina.

visual.text: Ayu is as tall than Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as tall than Rina.

items.reteach: Sama tinggi: as + adjective dasar + as.

items.prompt: Rewrite with "not as … as" and keep the meaning: "Malang is cooler than Surabaya."

visual.text: Surabaya is not as cool as Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not as cool as Malang.

visual.text: Malang is not as cool as Surabaya.

choices.say: Malang is not as cool as Surabaya.

visual.text: Surabaya is not as cooler as Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not as cooler as Malang.

visual.text: Surabaya is not so cool than Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not so cool than Malang.

items.reteach: A cooler than B = B not as cool as A.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "There are some mangoes in the basket."

visual.text: There aren't some mangoes in the basket.
